decision: Best located downloadable real-recording research candidate; NOT an admissible calibrated NET measured-thermal source

selected.title: Sensorless Battery Internal Temperature Estimation using a Kalman Filter with Impedance Measurement
selected.origin: Real experiments on an A123 ANR26650 m1-A 2.3 Ah LiFePO4 cell; retrieved MAT files are author-labelled raw experimental measurements. Repository also contains simulations, which were not selected.

license.scope: Repository LICENSE.txt permits source/binary redistribution; README explicitly calls this a code license. No separate explicit dataset license found in reviewed repository; retain author copyright and avoid overstating standalone dataset licensing.

channel_assessment.mapping_status: Measured column exists; Celsius-to-Kelvin needs an explicit retained transformation receipt.
channel_assessment.calibration_status: No thermocouple calibration certificate, serial number, validity interval, application receipt or per-sample covariance found in downloaded material.

channel_assessment.mapping_status: Independent physical location documented. Reserve this column only for comparison. Distinct instrument device identity and metrological independence are not established by repository metadata.
channel_assessment.calibration_status: Not established. Cannot invent device IDs or validity dates.

channel_assessment.mapping_status: Measured T_inf column exists. Preserve actual varying values instead of substituting MainScript P.T_inf=8.0.
No independently measured heat-power channel. Paper's heat estimate derives Q from measured I,V and assumed OCV; this is model-derived heat, not calibrated power measurement.
channel_assessment.unit_evidence: MainScript's load comment says I(mA), but plotted labels, numerical range -23..30, and paper report amperes. Record this inconsistency if a converter is later authored.

timing.electrical_sampling: Irregular; exact intervals are in inventory.json.
timing.absolute_acquisition_epoch: Not supplied. MATLAB creation metadata is not an acquisition timestamp.
timing.net_mismatch: NET presently requires 1..128 equally spaced rows first timestamp dt. Candidate full recordings contain thousands of rows and channels use different clocks/sampling. A documented selection/alignment or interval integration policy is needed; none has been applied.

unused_fields.status: Undocumented in MainScript's temperature mapping; do not assign a semantic role.

held_out.paper_design: First current-excitation profile fits thermal parameters; second profile validates them.
held_out.proposed_split: T_data_1 / VC_data_1 development only; T_data_2 / VC_data_2 held-out assessment only. This is a prospective NET adaptation proposal, not evidence the NET model was already qualified.

critical_leakage.consequence: Reusing author's Q_tot feeds held-out core data into heat input. Never use this quantity for a claimed independent held-out NET assessment.
critical_leakage.alternative: Paper states entropic heat neglected. A separately declared ohmic-only heat estimate from I,V and OCV could avoid core leakage, but needs justified sign/unit convention, uncertainty/model discrepancy and a contract capable of identifying derived power. Do not silently label derived power as observed.

model.published_structure: Polynomial approximation of radial heat-conduction PDE, with states mean temperature and mean radial gradient; not NET's core/shell two-capacity model.
model.parameter_origin: Radius, volume, coolant temperature and density labelled measured in MainScript; cp, conductivity and convection labelled identified using cycle 1.
model.missing_net_parameters: No published direct mapping to NET C_core,C_shell,G_core_shell,G_shell_ambient. Require separate model reduction/fit using development data and retained justification.

blocking_gaps: Calibration certificates/application receipts and measurement uncertainty for all relevant sensors are absent from selected downloaded material.
Heat power is derived from electrical signals and assumptions, not a calibrated independent observed stream.
No acquisition epoch, clock calibration, valid_from/valid_until or traceable per-device identities are available.
Author code's total-heat calculation uses core reference and would violate a held-out claim.
Published model parameters do not specify NET two-capacity model.
Time alignment, bounded-window selection and processing uncertainty need explicit declarations.
No NET-specific frozen prior/Q/R/criteria, repeatability/drift study or empirical uncertainty coverage exists for this dataset.
Public author data are useful for research but cannot be promoted to a physically qualified customer pilot by relabelling metadata.

alternatives.title: NIST mds2-4027 safe intervention thermal-abuse thermocouple data
alternatives.origin: Real thermocouple surface temperatures under approximately 41 W external heating.
alternatives.rejection: Catalog describes surface-only temperatures, no independently measured core reference, and thermal-abuse/ignition dynamics unsuitable for the unqualified linear two-capacity model.

alternatives.title: Enclosed NMC pouch-cell luminescence surface temperature
alternatives.origin: Real surface-temperature imaging with electrical I,V and SoC/DoD.
alternatives.rejection: README enumerates no core-reference or measured heat-power channel; not a complete four-stream thermal pilot. Dataset license not rendered on viewed page.

alternatives.title: TCLab APMonitor datasets
alternatives.origin: Teaching files and hardware/simulator routes; selected file provenance not independently verified in this assessment.
alternatives.rejection: T1/T2 are sensors on separate heater assemblies; they must not be renamed shell/core. Q1/Q2 are commanded percentages, not measured watts. No independent core reference or calibration bundle established.

alternatives.title: Anthony et al. thermal test cell, Scientific Reports 2016
alternatives.origin: Real internally heated test cylinder with IR surface data, embedded core thermocouple and monitored electrical heat input; paper reports IR calibration.
alternatives.rejection: Promising apparatus fit, but bounded search found no openly downloadable original numerical recordings or full calibration bundle. Figures were not digitized or treated as raw data.

reproduction.operations: Verifies pinned source hashes and inventories MAT arrays; never executes upstream MATLAB or emits a NET measured source.
